skill.summary: Stripe API skill. Use when working with Stripe for account, account_links, account_sessions. Covers 587 endpoints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of lap-stripe-api skill

- Provides access to 587 Stripe API endpoints across 76 groups.
- Supports key resources: account, account_links, account_sessions, accounts, application_fees, apple_pay, apps, balance, billing, billing_portal, charges, and more.
- Requires STRIPE_API_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Offers setup instructions for verifying access and creating account links.
- Documents all major paths and methods for easy integration with Stripe API version 2026-02-25.clover.
